name: vista-computer-use
description: Drive the Vista vphone/QEMU iOS emulator and the Vista host service through MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Control the vphone iOS emulator and Vista host
interface.longDescription: Inspect and drive a vphone/QEMU iOS guest with accessibility tools, screenshots and input, install and launch apps, read logs, and run the Vista host service with its reference client.
defaultPrompt: Check the vphone VM, open the Vista client, and verify it can pair with the host service.
